$comment: 听力训练营 L20（P-L2 阶段二末课）。脚本 100% 原创；阶段二 · Part 4 主旨三选一（5 段，每段含转折，接近真考）+ Part 2 笔记填空（一段独白 5 空，五类混合：地名拼读 H-A-R-T-L-E-Y、时间、价格 £4.50、姓名拼读 N-O-L-A-N、电话号码）。词汇 ≥95% 落在 KET A2 词表，超出的词进 warmup。语速 0.9x。
title: A Day at the Museum
intro: 阶段二最后一课，接近真考：五段都在博物馆，每段有转折——换了博物馆、恐龙馆关了、哪里能拍照、以为无聊结果很棒、餐厅满了改野餐。再听一段博物馆讲解员的开场，五个空五种类型。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，注意 but 后面说了什么。

script.text: Class, a change to Friday's trip. We were going to the science museum, but it's closed for building work until June.
So we're going to the art museum on Friday. It's the same day, and the bus still leaves at nine, so nothing else changes.

questions.q: What is the teacher telling the class?
options: They will go to a different museum.
The trip is on a different day.
questions.explain: were going to the science museum, but it's closed… So we're going to the art museum——换了博物馆。same day / nothing else changes 说明日子和车都没变。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，注意 but 后面说了什么。

script.text: Mia, let's go to the dinosaur room first. It's the best part of the museum.
I wanted to, but look at the sign. It's closed today, they're cleaning it.
Oh no! What about the old ships, then? They're upstairs.
OK, ships first, and we can see the old cars after lunch.

questions.q: What are Tom and Mia going to see first?
questions.explain: 恐龙馆 closed today；What about the old ships? → OK, ships first。老爷车是午饭后看。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，注意 but 后面说了什么。

script.text: Welcome, everyone. You can take photos in most of the museum, and we love seeing them online.
But not in the painting rooms on the first floor, the light is bad for the old paintings. Thank you.

questions.q: What is the woman telling the visitors?
questions.explain: can take photos in most of the museum, But not in the painting rooms——在说哪里能拍、哪里不能拍。买照片和价格没提。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，注意 but 后面说了什么。

script.text: I thought the museum would be boring, just old things in glass boxes. I didn't want to go.
But the old cars were great, you can sit in them! I want to go back with my dad next weekend.

questions.q: What does the boy say about the museum?
options: It was better than he thought.
questions.explain: I thought… boring 是去之前的想法，But the old cars were great / want to go back——比想的好得多。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，注意 but 后面说了什么。

script.text: Mum, I'm hungry. Can we have lunch in the museum café now?
I wanted to, but it's full, there's a queue out of the door.
So what do we do?
I've got sandwiches in my bag. Let's eat them in the garden outside, it's sunny.

questions.q: Where will Amy and her mum have lunch?
questions.explain: wanted to（想去 café），but it's full → Let's eat them in the garden outside，改在外面花园吃。

sections.intro: 听一段博物馆讲解员的开场，把笔记补全。五个空五种类型：地名拼读、时间、价格、姓名拼读、电话。

script.text: Good morning, and welcome to the Hartley Museum. That's H-A-R-T-L-E-Y. My name is Mr Nolan, and I'm your guide today.
The museum opens at half past nine every day and closes at five. On Thursdays we stay open until eight.
Tickets are nine pounds for adults and four pounds fifty for children. Under fives are free, and so are school groups on Fridays.
If you have questions later, ask me or Mrs Nolan, my wife. She works in the shop. Nolan is N-O-L-A-N.
To book a guide for your next visit, call the museum on two two oh, six one eight three. That's two two oh, six one eight three.
Now, let's start with the dinosaurs. Follow me, please.

questions.explain: welcome to the Hartley Museum. That's H-A-R-T-L-E-Y，照拼读写。
opens at half past nine = 9:30。five 和 eight 是关门时间。
four pounds fifty for children = £4.50。nine pounds 是成人票。
My name is Mr Nolan … Nolan is N-O-L-A-N，拼读在后面才出现，先记下听到的名字再对拼读。
two two oh, six one eight three = 220 6183。号码会重复一遍。
